description: Curated GIS, Earth-science and place-search service directory; free quotas, evaluation, production rights and hosted/self-hosted use are distinct.
policy: Verify live docs, quotas, keys, data licenses, geographic/temporal coverage and uptime before production use; never hardcode credentials; obey caching and attribution rules. Default free-only recommendations use cost_tier free-self-hosted or free-conditional only, subject to account, scientific data and terms verification. Pricing groups for geocoding are separate subtypes.

access_vocabulary.free-noncommercial: Free only within noncommercial fair-use quota; commercial use requires a separate plan or permission.
access_vocabulary.free-key-required: Free tier available after personal API key issuance; no shared embedded keys.
access_vocabulary.free-registration: Registration and personal access token needed for programmatic access.
access_vocabulary.free-limited: Low-volume public trial or free key tier.
access_vocabulary.public-fair-use: Open public entry point without unlimited traffic, availability or asset redistribution promise.
access_vocabulary.public-with-asset-restrictions: Open catalog; asset access or volumes may require signing, auth or throttling.
access_vocabulary.restricted-public: Public endpoint with explicit strict usage policy, unsuitable for bulk/generic integrations.
access_vocabulary.temporarily-unavailable: Provider reports service unavailable; use alternatives.
access_vocabulary.self-hosted-open-source: Open-source deployable engine, not a guaranteed public hosted API.
access_vocabulary.commercial-metered: Commercial platform requiring billing and/or paid entitlements; any free allowance is conditional.
access_vocabulary.free-trial: Provider explicitly limits the free entitlement to testing or evaluation.

services.name: Open-Meteo Forecast
services.limits: Free non-commercial service: <10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour, 600/minute; commercial subscriptions required.
services.attribution: CC BY 4.0 data attribution to Open-Meteo and applicable original sources.
services.caveat: Forecast model availability and native resolution vary by area; do not represent forecasts as ground station observations.

services.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather
services.limits: Same free non-commercial Open-Meteo service limits; data coverage/resolution depend on selected model.
services.attribution: CC BY 4.0 data attribution.
services.caveat: Select a consistent source/model over the entire study period; reanalysis is gridded, not a station record.

services.name: NASA POWER Temporal API
services.limits: Respect service 429/rate constraints; point daily API has parameter constraints; avoid redundant requests over same coarse grid cell.
services.attribution: Cite NASA POWER, underlying source data and version according to product guidelines.
services.caveat: Spatial/time resolution and near-real-time latency vary. Daily values may be local solar time unless explicitly set.

services.name: Copernicus Climate Data Store CDS API
services.limits: Account and personal access token required; accept the requested dataset-specific licence; job queues and size restrictions apply.
services.attribution: Cite ECMWF/Copernicus and specific dataset/licence.
services.caveat: Use CDS API client and secrets via environment or private configuration, not source control.

services.name: Open-Meteo Elevation API
services.limits: Up to 100 coordinates per request; general Open-Meteo non-commercial rate limits apply.
services.attribution: Open-Meteo/Copernicus DEM source attribution.
services.caveat: Uses Copernicus GLO-90, roughly 90 m; not a survey-grade height or local high-resolution DEM.

services.name: OpenTopography Global DEM API
services.coverage: global coverage depends on DEM selection
services.limits: Free academic key generally 200 calls/day and non-academic 50/day for global datasets; product and area limits apply.
services.attribution: Dataset-specific attribution; review OpenTopography API agreement.
services.caveat: Never embed or redistribute a personal key in a desktop or multiuser app; commercial software integration may require Enterprise access.

services.name: Open-Elevation Hosted API
services.limits: Public no-key trial: up to 500 coordinates/month per IP; free account/key advertised up to 1,000 coordinates/month.
services.attribution: SRTM/NASA data and service attribution per current provider terms.
services.caveat: Approximate/resampled heights; no-data may return 0; self-hostable GPLv2 server has separate licence.

services.name: USGS Elevation Point Query Service
services.limits: Public point queries; USGS service policies and availability may change.
services.attribution: USGS 3DEP attribution recommended.
services.caveat: Not a globally applicable DEM service. Elevations are interpolated from varying 3DEP resolutions.

services.name: Element 84 Earth Search STAC
services.limits: Free public catalog with no guaranteed SLA. Assets may have their own rules or requester-pays S3 links.
services.attribution: Cite original dataset provider and asset terms.
services.caveat: STAC search metadata is not itself a basemap or unrestricted satellite image redistribution.

services.name: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC
services.limits: STAC search anonymously available; most assets can be read without account but are throttled and sometimes need signed URLs or tokens.
services.attribution: Original collection/provider licences and required attribution.
services.caveat: Do not treat anonymous catalogue access as an unlimited anonymous asset download licence.

services.name: Copernicus Data Space APIs
services.limits: Catalog/search and actual processing/download endpoints have differing authentication, quota and subscription/access rules.
services.attribution: Copernicus Sentinel data-use terms and provider acknowledgements.
services.caveat: Obtain tokens through official flow when required; do not publish refresh credentials.

services.name: NASA GIBS Web Map Services
services.limits: Follow layer-specific temporal, projection, attribution and terms; no public SLA.
services.attribution: NASA Earthdata product-specific credits.
services.caveat: GIBS map images are visualization services; not a substitute for the underlying scientific pixel data or original raster.

services.name: OpenFreeMap Hosted Styles
services.limits: Site advertises no public map-view/request limit; offline per-download limit 3,000 tiles or 50 MB with max 4 concurrent requests; terms may evolve.
services.attribution: Visible OpenStreetMap/OpenMapTiles attribution as applicable.
services.caveat: Hosted service best-effort; do not assume unlimited bulk download or remove attribution.

services.name: OSM Foundation Standard Tile Server
services.limits: No bulk/offline prefetching; use correct attribution and valid identifying client; no SLA; block risk for heavy use.
services.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL for OSM data).
services.caveat: Not a free unlimited production tile CDN and not suitable for harvesting tiles.

services.name: OSM Overpass Public API
services.limits: Shared volunteer instances subject to load/usage policies; avoid large or repeated bulk queries and cache results.
services.attribution: OSM contributors / ODbL.
services.caveat: For high-volume operations use planet/regional extracts or self-host rather than public API.

services.name: Pelias Open-Source Geocoder
services.limits: MIT open-source geocoder; self-hosting requires compute, storage and data imports; there is NO official unlimited free hosted Pelias API.
services.attribution: Pelias MIT code license; each imported dataset keeps its own terms/attribution.
use_cases: self-hosted multilingual POI and gazetteer search
services.caveat: service_url is source code, not a live geocoding API endpoint. Do not equate free software with free hosting; optional hosted Geocode Earth is a separate commercial provider.

services.name: ISRIC SoilGrids REST API
services.limits: Official site reports the REST service temporarily paused as of 2026-10-24; no restoration ETA.
services.attribution: ISRIC SoilGrids data-specific citation.
services.caveat: Do not build runtime dependency on paused service. See ISRIC alternate WCS/WebDAV data access.

services.name: GBIF Occurrence API
services.limits: Search endpoint max 300 records per page and offset pagination totals 100,000 records; use download API for bulk.
services.attribution: Cite GBIF download DOI and original publishers/datasets as appropriate.
services.caveat: Species occurrence coordinates may be generalized or imprecise; sensitive species data require care.

services.name: geoBoundaries
services.coverage: Global administrative boundaries; levels vary by country
services.limits: No guaranteed public throughput; cache only in line with source license
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Boundary editions and original layer licenses vary; gbOpen generally CC BY 4.0

services.name: WorldPop API v2
services.coverage: Global modeled population datasets by year
services.limits: 1,000 daily no-key requests; 50,000 square km maximum no-key polygon
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Population is modeled rather than official census; asynchronous tasks may apply

services.name: Open-Meteo Geocoding API
services.coverage: Worldwide location and postcode search; not a complete address/POI directory
services.limits: Free no-key for non-commercial use; shared Open-Meteo fair-use caps (around 10,000 calls/day); commercial licensing/plan differs.
services.attribution: Open-Meteo attribution/CC BY 4.0 where applicable.
services.caveat: Use as city/location finder, not a rooftop street-address geocoder; localized labels and coverage may differ.

services.name: NASA FIRMS Area API
services.limits: Free map key; 5,000 map transactions per 10 minutes, area requests 1 to 5 days
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Hotspots are not burned-area perimeters; product latency differs

services.name: USGS Earthquake Event API
services.limits: Fair-use and result limits; restrict queries by bounding box and time
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Locations/depths uncertain and catalogue records may be revised

services.name: NASA Earthdata CMR Search
services.limits: Paging and service constraints; downloads may require Earthdata Login
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Metadata discovery does not grant access to every asset

services.name: OpenAQ v3 Observations
services.limits: Free key: 60 requests/minute and 2,000/hour
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Ground observations not modeled air quality; harmonize timestamps and units

services.name: Open-Meteo Air Quality API
services.limits: Free noncommercial limits: under 10,000 daily, 5,000 hourly, 600 per minute
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Forecast model grids not observed sensor data; attribute original CAMS inputs

services.name: Open-Meteo Flood GloFAS
services.coverage: Global modeled river discharge at about 5 km
services.limits: Open-Meteo noncommercial fair-use quotas apply
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: Discharge (m3/s) is not an inundation polygon or an ephemeral wadi map

services.name: HeiGIT ohsome API v2
services.limits: Free key with account plan quotas; v1 retires 2026-11-30
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
services.caveat: OSM edit time is not real-world building date; do not use deprecated v2-rc

services.name: HeiGIT openrouteservice v2
services.coverage: Global where OpenStreetMap routing graph available
services.limits: Free Standard plan quotas vary by directions, isochrone and matrix endpoint
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: Use new api.heigit.org host; old api.openrouteservice.org is being shut down in November 2026

services.name: HDX Humanitarian API HAPI
services.coverage: Humanitarian datasets by country and administrative zone
services.limits: Generate free app identifier; use filtering, pagination and fair-use quotas
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: Original dataset has its own temporal coverage, spatial references and attribution

services.name: USGS Water Data OGC API
services.limits: Paged modern OGC collections and fair-use limits
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: US-only; legacy WaterServices endpoints retire in early 2027

services.name: NOAA CO-OPS Tides and Currents API
services.limits: Station/product-specific date limits and usage guidelines
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
use_cases: NOAA CO-OPS Tides and Currents API
services.caveat: Requires explicit tidal datum, units, station ID and time zone

services.name: NASA EONET Natural Events v3
services.limits: Use bounding box, category, day and limit parameters with fair use
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: Curated natural events not a complete scientific disaster census

services.name: World Bank Indicators API v2
services.limits: Paged API with responsible request use
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: National statistical totals are not local population grids

services.name: NOAA NCEI Climate Data Online v2
services.coverage: Station archives vary by NOAA dataset
services.limits: Free token: 5 requests/second and 10,000 requests/day
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
use_cases: NOAA NCEI Climate Data Online v2
services.caveat: Station records need quality and missing-value checks

services.name: NOAA NCEI ERDDAP
services.coverage: Dataset-specific gridded/tabular marine and ocean data
services.limits: Use bounded griddap/tabledap subsets; dataset size/access varies
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: ERDDAP gateway does not mean every dataset permits all reuse

services.name: iNaturalist Observations API
services.limits: Recommended ~1 request/sec, under 10,000/day; max throttle 100/min; no bulk exports
services.attribution: Credit the service provider and the original contributing dataset under its own license.
services.caveat: Sensitive species coordinates may be obscured; respect observation and image licenses

services.name: GEBCO_2026 Global Seafloor/Land Terrain WMS
services.coverage: Global land and ocean; GEBCO_2026 15-arc-second underlying grid
services.limits: Public WMS with no unlimited request allowance or uptime guarantee; obtain layer IDs via GetCapabilities and make bounded GetMap requests.
services.attribution: GEBCO Bathymetric Compilation Group 2026 (2026), GEBCO_2026 Grid, doi:10.5285/4f68d5c7-45eb-f999-e063-7086abc036fa; public domain with source acknowledgment required.
use_cases: land and ocean topographic map layers
services.caveat: WMS is rendered map imagery and NOT numeric DEM cell data; not suitable for quantitative terrain modeling. GEBCO must NOT be used for navigation or other safety-at-sea uses. Mean sea level vertical reference is approximate in some coastal areas.

services.name: GEBCO_2026 Bathymetry/Topography via CEDA OPeNDAP
services.authentication: Check current CEDA dataset/OPeNDAP access conditions; no shared keys
services.coverage: Global ocean and land; 15 arc-second WGS84 lat/lon grid, ~463 m at equator (grid interval only)
formats: GeoTIFF through official separate download tool
Esri ASCII through official separate download tool
services.limits: Free public-domain dataset but no verified unlimited OPeNDAP quota; prefer spatial subsets, verify authentication/constraint syntax and avoid whole-global multi-GB transfer.
services.attribution: GEBCO Bathymetric Compilation Group 2026 (2026), GEBCO_2026 Grid, doi:10.5285/4f68d5c7-45eb-f999-e063-7086abc036fa. Free commercial/noncommercial reuse with required credit.
use_cases: numeric ocean bathymetry and land elevation rasters
services.caveat: Official CEDA NetCDF archive file; OPeNDAP constraint syntax and current access must be checked at runtime. Land elevations positive, underwater depths negative (m). TID identifies measured/predicted/interpolated data. Grid spacing is not actual bathymetric accuracy; vertical reference approximates mean sea level with local variations. Not for marine navigation.

services.name: OSM Foundation Nominatim Public API
services.limits: Absolute maximum 1 request/second per application; identifying User-Agent/Referer; no autocomplete; no systematic scraping.
services.attribution: OSM contributors / ODbL.
services.caveat: OSMF-hosted server is NOT for autocomplete, systematic/bulk extraction, generic geocoding backends, or white-label geocoding services. Do not embed as automatic fallback in agent-generated apps; use permissioned or self-hosted alternatives.

services.name: Photon OSM Geocoder (public demo / self-host)
services.limits: Public demonstration is best-effort; undocumented reasonable-use threshold, throttling or bans; self-host for production volume.
services.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL; Photon software license separately.
services.caveat: The demo is NOT a guaranteed commercial production backend; no fixed daily allowance is published. Self-hosting requires OSM import and server resources.

services.name: Esri ArcGIS World Geocoding Service
services.authentication: ArcGIS Location Platform API key / account
services.limits: ArcGIS Location Platform: 20,000 free *non-stored geocodes* per month according to pricing; stored/batch stored geocodes are billed. Suggestions currently shown at $0 in platform pricing.
services.attribution: Esri and licensed source attribution per service terms.
services.caveat: Charges may be per result returned rather than per request; 'forStorage=true' changes billing. Do not cache stored geocodes on non-stored entitlement.

services.name: Geoapify Geocoding & Autocomplete
services.coverage: Global addresses, cities and OSM POIs
services.limits: Free 3,000 credits/day, up to 5 requests/second; a typical forward/reverse/autocomplete request costs one credit. Free plan can serve commercial production with required attribution.
services.attribution: Geoapify and underlying OSM contributors attribution.
services.caveat: Keep API keys private; check feature-specific costs, result storage and applicable third-party dataset licenses.

services.name: geocode.maps.co Geocoding
services.limits: Free Demo Account advertises 25,000 requests at up to 5 requests/second, then throttling to 1 request/second; plan page says no daily limit. Verify current policy and applicability.
services.attribution: Credit data suppliers and site as contract requires; OSM attribution where applicable.
services.caveat: Demo/free allowance is not 25,000 requests per day; do not interpret it as a daily reset, or assume commercial production permissions.

services.name: GeoNames Web Services
services.limits: 10,000 credits/day and 1,000 credits/hour per username (typically one search request = one credit); attribution and CC BY apply.
services.attribution: Cite named provider, original underlying dataset and applicable per-product license.
use_cases: gazetteer of cities, villages, mountains, rivers and geographic names
services.caveat: Validate transliteration and administrative names; GeoNames data CC BY

services.name: LocationIQ Geocoding & Autocomplete
services.limits: Free 5,000 requests/day with 2 requests/second; limited commercial use requires a prominent powered-by LocationIQ link and compliance with their terms.
services.attribution: LocationIQ attribution; OSM contributors where used.
services.caveat: Free terms require attribution; rate ceilings and data storage rights must be reviewed before embedding.

services.name: MapTiler Geocoding
services.limits: Free Cloud plan currently lists 1,000 search sessions/month and 100,000 total API requests/month across product use; verify free-vs-commercial plan terms and search session accounting.
services.attribution: MapTiler and OSM/data source attribution.
services.caveat: Search sessions and general API request quota are distinct; hosted free plan conditions may restrict commercial deployment; do not promise unrestricted production use.

services.name: OpenCage Geocoding Trial
services.limits: Free trial: 2,500 requests/day at 1 request/second, explicitly TESTING ONLY; ongoing production use requires a paid plan.
services.attribution: OpenCage and constituent open-data attribution.
services.caveat: Do not deploy ongoing production workloads under trial; must upgrade for sustained service use despite seemingly ample daily credits.

services.name: Google Places API (New) Text Search
services.authentication: Google Maps Platform project with billing + key
services.coverage: Global place/business search depending on region
services.limits: Commercial SKU pricing and monthly free usage caps vary by operation/field mask; account billing must be enabled. Do not infer 2,500 daily free geocodes.
services.attribution: Google Maps Platform Places policies, attribution and display restrictions.
services.caveat: Text search is POST and requires field mask; returned data storage/caching and map usage are license-constrained; choose minimal billable fields.

services.name: HERE Geocoding & Search
services.limits: Commercial/account-plan allowances may include a free tier; verify current plan, billable transactions and rates before use.
services.attribution: HERE and relevant data-owner attribution terms.
services.caveat: Autosuggest uses a separate HERE endpoint and location context; enterprise features and caching rights are plan-dependent.

services.name: Mapbox Search Box API
services.coverage: Regional/global POI and address coverage varies
services.limits: Commercial metering: /suggest + /retrieve billed by search sessions (free monthly allowance varies by pricing tier); /category and /reverse per request.
services.attribution: Mapbox attribution and search data terms.
services.caveat: Search Box coordinates are temporary-use only without separate agreement; session_token required for suggest/retrieve; do not archive results in GIS datasets as permanent coordinates.

services.name: TomTom Search / Places Search
services.coverage: Global POIs, roads and addresses; regional differences
services.limits: Free developer allowances and commercial overage depend on the plan; verify current Search/Places pricing and per-second caps.
services.attribution: TomTom Maps data attribution and license.
services.caveat: TomTom recommends Places Search API for new applications; legacy Search v2 remains documented. Do not assume new and old API endpoints share quotas.

pricing_groups.self-hosted-open-source: Open-source software hosted by the developer; no third-party hosted quota is implied.
pricing_groups.public-fair-use: Public or no-key service with specific restrictions, rate limits or non-commercial conditions.
pricing_groups.free-with-quota: Free service allowance under provider-specific account/key, daily/monthly limits and licensing.
pricing_groups.trial-only: Free for evaluation only; not an ongoing free production entitlement.
pricing_groups.commercial: Commercial/metered service; some billable SKUs may have free monthly allowances.

cost_tiers.free-self-hosted: Open-source service that you operate; hosting/resources may cost.
cost_tiers.restricted: Public-facing endpoint with strict policy; not default free-only app backend.
cost_tiers.trial: Temporary/test-only free evaluation; not a durable free service.
cost_tiers.commercial: Billing or commercial platform; any free allowance is conditional.
cost_tiers.unavailable: Source reports unavailable; never recommend as active without checking.
